prompt: A colleague presents an idea you suggested in a team meeting as their own, and your manager loves it. What is the most constructive first response?

options.text: Call them a liar in the meeting so everyone knows whose idea it was
Stay silent for good and stop sharing ideas in meetings from now on
Tell other colleagues about it afterwards so they turn against the presenter

Stay calm in the meeting, add your supporting detail naturally if useful, then speak privately to your colleague afterwards about sharing credit, raising it with your manager only if it keeps happening

explanation: A calm private conversation gives your colleague a chance to correct the pattern without a public fight. Calling them out angrily, gossiping, or withdrawing your ideas all cost you more than they fix.
